name: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd.
business_summary: Hyderabad-based vertically integrated generics maker: oral solids, injectables (Eugia), antiretrovirals, APIs and growing biosimilars/CRDMO. US is ~47% of sales, Europe ~28% (model estimates). Q2 FY27: sales Rs 10,263 cr (record, +24% YoY), operating profit Rs 2,153 cr (21%), PAT Rs 1,124 cr (+32.5%). Interim dividend Rs 7. Stock at 52-week high (Rs 1,755; 12m +52.7%).

exposures.mechanism: Exports (US ~47%, Europe ~28%, ARV/RoW) ~80% of sales (model knowledge). +3% USD/INR: foreign revenue +2.4% of sales; imported RM/KSM from China ~20% of sales -0.6% => +1.8% of sales / OPM 21% = +8.6% EBITDA; hedging, persistence 0.4, EV/MCap 1.03 -> +3.5, trimmed to 3.2. Empirical +1.46 (t=1.0) agrees.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 net profit +32.5% to Rs 1,124 cr, record revenue Rs 10,263 cr (Moneycontrol, CNBC TV18); Rs 7 interim dividend

exposures.mechanism: US ~47% of sales: +5pp extra erosion -> -2.35% of sales / OPM 21% = -11% EBITDA, new launches (Adquey 2026-10-01, perampanel) offset ~half, persistence 0.5 -> -5.0.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 net profit +32.5% to Rs 1,124 cr, record revenue Rs 10,263 cr (Moneycontrol, CNBC TV18); Rs 7 interim dividend

exposures.mechanism: 100% US tariff on branded/patented drugs since 2026-09-29, India specialty exempted (Business Standard). Generics outside scope per model knowledge; the tail is Section 232 extension to generics: probability 8% x impact -30% (US half of EBITDA at risk, partial price-sharing) -> -2.4; add biosimilar/injectable exposure -> -3.0.
Large unit count (Eugia, Unit-III etc.); past OAI/warning history at Eugia Pharma and Unit-IV (model knowledge). Probability of new material action ~15% x impact -25% -> -4.
